##converting dates to numbers:


```{r}

install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("lubridate")
install.packages("readr")
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)



coerce_date <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  out <- suppressWarnings(ymd(x))
  if (all(is.na(out))) out <- suppressWarnings(dmy(x))
  if (all(is.na(out))) out <- suppressWarnings(mdy(x))
  if (all(is.na(out))) out <- suppressWarnings(readr::parse_date(x,
                      locale = locale(date_names = "en")))
  as.Date(out)
}
#cleaning data all across all column

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Traded        = coerce_date(Traded),
    Filed         = coerce_date(Filed),
    last_modified = coerce_date(last_modified)
  )

View(df)
# write_csv(df, "project_clean.csv")
```


## Converting trade size usd into intervall


```{r}


# Robust function to handle vectors properly
parse_min_max <- function(x) {
  # If x is NA or empty (works for vectors of length 1)
  if (length(x) != 1 || is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") return(c(min = NA, max = NA))
  
  # Remove $ and commas
  x_clean <- gsub("[$,]", "", as.character(x))
  
  # Extract all numbers (integer or decimal)
  nums <- as.numeric(unlist(regmatches(x_clean, gregexpr("[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", x_clean))))
  
  # If no numbers found
  if (length(nums) == 0) return(c(min = NA, max = NA))
  
  # Return min and max
  c(min = min(nums, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(nums, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Apply to the entire column safely
parsed <- t(sapply(as.character(df$Trade_Size_USD), parse_min_max))
parsed <- as.data.frame(parsed)

# Add min and max columns to your dataframe
df$Trade_Size_USD_min <- parsed$min
df$Trade_Size_USD_max <- parsed$max

View(df)

```

## Creating Trade Delay (in days)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    trade_delay = as.numeric(Filed - Traded)
  )

# Quick check
summary(df$trade_delay)
head(df$trade_delay)

## Creating Net Trade Direction

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    net_trade_direction = case_when(
      Transaction == "Purchase"           ~ 1,
      Transaction %in% c("Sale", "Sale (Partial)", "Sale (Full)") ~ -1,
      Transaction == "Exchange"           ~ 0,   # or NA_real_ if you prefer
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

head(df[, c("Transaction", "net_trade_direction")])

total_direction <- sum(df$net_trade_direction, na.rm = TRUE)
total_direction
